ReadingChanged On responds in both; Off inert in both (parity).
Register Task responds in UWP golden (updates Status bar) but is DEAD in WinUI (invoked, no output/status change).
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: async void handler calls BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync() (unsupported/throws in WinUI 3 desktop); with no try/catch the exception is swallowed and the control appears dead. Inventory flags BackgroundTaskBuilder but not the throwing RequestAccessAsync call; PATTERNS.md#background-tasks lacks a runtime-behavior warning.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Status bar updates to a device-gated message (e.g. 'Access denied to activity sensors'); Task Registration/Status fields refresh.
visual_discrepancies.winui: No visible response — no status text change, post-click frame unchanged.

summary: Only regression: 'Register Task' is a present-yet-dead control because the migrated async void handler calls the out-of-process UWP background API BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync(), which throws in WinUI 3 desktop, and the swallowed exception yields no UI feedback.
